question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is "**comprises**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The subject of the given passage is the international forum of G20.
 
• **Now, blank 1 indicates that the G20 includes the 19 countries and European union.**
 
• Among the given options the most appropriate word to fill in blank 1 is "comprises."
 
 
• Comprises" means to consist of or include.</strong
